notes_for_editor: Only the Landforms table row and the absence from the 2014 list support the story. Two web searches and the cached NHLR Tennessee index found nothing else about this tower. The record has no NGS code and no Wikipedia article was found (404 on the guessed title). Record county, elevation (191.1 m) and removed status agree with Landforms. No photos.
